raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Zero (or negative) values for a handful of integer knobs are currently accepted by config validation and fail later in ways that do not name the knob:

| override | current main (3efe38c) |
|---|---|
| `trainer.n_gpus_per_node=0` | `ZeroDivisionError` *inside* `validate_config` (`utils/config.py:124` — the modulo runs before the assert can format its message) |
| `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=0` (or `data_parallel_size=0`) | `ZeroDivisionError` at `engine_workers.py:658`, after ray + model init (~60 s); the explanatory assert is one line below the division |
| `actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=0` | `ZeroDivisionError` at `engine/utils.py:125`, after init and the first rollout (~2 min) |
| `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=0` | after ~2 min: `RuntimeError: Sync replay buffer selected terminal groups with no materializable trajectories. Enable trainer.v1.sampler.sync_refill_failed_groups...` — names an unrelated setting |

This PR validates these at config construction with errors that name the parameter:
- `RolloutConfig.__post_init__`: `n`, `tensor_model_parallel_size`, `data_parallel_size`, `pipeline_model_parallel_size` must be positive integers.
- `ActorConfig` / `CriticConfig.__post_init__`: `ppo_mini_batch_size`, `ppo_micro_batch_size`, `ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu` must be positive when set.
- `validate_config`: `trainer.n_gpus_per_node * trainer.nnodes` must be `> 0`.
- The two engine-side asserts now check positivity before dividing, so they fail with their own message instead of `ZeroDivisionError` if reached some other way.

No behavior change for valid configs.

Note: the `RolloutConfig` checks fire where the dataclass is instantiated today (worker construction, after ray init), so they surface at ~1 min rather than ~7 s; instantiating the rollout config from `validate_config` as well would move them to the driver and could be a follow-up.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Query links: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+ZeroDivisionError , https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues?q=is%3Aopen+RolloutConfig+post_init , https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues?q=is%3Aopen+validate_config+n_gpus (no open PR or issue covers these checks)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

Unit tests (CPU):
- `tests/workers/config/test_config_positive_values_on_cpu.py` — `RolloutConfig` rejects `0`/`-1` for the four fields and accepts positives; actor and critic reject `ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=0`; valid values pass.
- `tests/trainer/test_validate_config_on_cpu.py` — `validate_config` raises a `ValueError` naming `trainer.n_gpus_per_node` for a zero GPU count (the check runs before model configs are instantiated, so no weights are needed on CPU).

```
python -m pytest -q tests/workers/config/test_config_positive_values_on_cpu.py tests/trainer/test_validate_config_on_cpu.py tests/workers/config/test_actor_config_on_cpu.py tests/workers/config/test_critic_config_on_cpu.py
# 15 passed, 10 skipped
```

End-to-end on 1×H100 (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, gsm8k, vllm rollout, 8 PPO steps), this branch:

| override | result |
|---|---|
| `trainer.n_gpus_per_node=0` | rejected in `validate_config` (6.9 s): `ValueError: trainer.n_gpus_per_node (0) * trainer.nnodes (1) must be > 0` |
| `rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=0` | rejected at rollout config construction (56 s, at worker init): `ValueError: rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size must be a positive integer, got 0` |
| `rollout.data_parallel_size=0` | rejected at rollout config construction (56 s, at worker init): `ValueError: rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size must be a positive integer, got 0`B |
| `actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=0` | rejected at config validation (7.0 s): `ValueError: [actor] ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu must be a positive integer, got 0` |
| `rollout.n=0` | rejected (58 s): `ValueError: rollout.n must be a positive integer, got 0` (was a replay-buffer `RuntimeError` after ~2 min) |
| control (no override) | 8/8 steps, unchanged |

### API and Usage Example

No API change; invalid values that previously crashed later now fail at config validation.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/workers/config/rollout.py`: positivity checks at the top of `RolloutConfig.__post_init__`.
- `verl/workers/config/actor.py`, `critic.py`: positivity checks for the PPO batch-size fields in `__post_init__`.
- `verl/utils/config.py`: `n_gpus > 0` guard before any divisibility arithmetic in `validate_config`.
- `verl/workers/engine_workers.py`, `verl/workers/engine/utils.py`: assert positivity before dividing.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [x] `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`
- [x] Docs: no user-facing API change (validation only); no doc update needed.
- [x] CPU unit tests added (picked up by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`).
- [ ] CI request sent in `ci-request`.

### AI-assisted contribution (per AGENTS.md)

- **AI assistance was used** (Claude) for part of the implementation and the unit-test drafts. Commits carry the `Co-authored-by: Claude` trailer.
- **Human review:** every changed line was reviewed by the submitter, who ran the test commands and the end-to-end experiments listed above.
- **Not a duplicate:** searched https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+ZeroDivisionError , https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues?q=is%3Aopen+RolloutConfig+post_init and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues?q=is%3Aopen+validate_config+n_gpus — no open PR or issue addresses this change.

inline_comments.body: The Actor/Critic checks do not currently enforce the stated positive-integer contract. They only raise when `value` is an `int` (and not `bool`) with `value < 1`, so values such as `False` and `0.5` bypass validation, unlike the stricter `RolloutConfig` check in this PR. Since direct dataclass/Hydra instantiation is part of this config path, could these loops use the same predicate as rollout for non-`None` values (`isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1`) and add bool/float cases to the table test?
